events.name: FREE FALLIN’ – The Tom Petty Experience / THE SILVER MULLET BAND – Tribute to Bob Seger
events.description: For nearly two decades, Free Fallin: The Tom Petty Concert Experience has faithfully recreated the sound, spirit, and energy of Tom Petty & The Heartbreakers. Featuring all the classic hits, Free Fallin delivers an authentic, high-energy concert that keeps Tom Petty's legendary music alive for fans of every generation.
